article.hook: You watch a meeting stretch on with more control battles than decisions. Pluto in Capricorn is the slow burn where power tightens its grip under cold discipline, shifting how we build and break at the same time.
article.lived: This transit lasts nearly two decades, carving deep grooves in ambition and authority. You notice it in the way promotions arrive only after relentless focus, how budgets are slashed with surgical precision, or when a team stays late not out of chaos but because every detail must be unshakeable. The urge to transform power here wears a tailored suit - it’s about remaking structures from the inside, with hands that never tremble.
article.turn: The same restraint that crafts order can freeze it into obsession. Control becomes a cage when you micromanage every step, turning trust into suspicion and collaboration into silent resentments. Discipline without release hardens into coldness. You don’t change systems by tightening the screws until they snap; you break them by refusing to loosen your grip.
moves: Call out one control grab in your workplace or project and ask why it’s happening now.
Draft a clear boundary around one ambition and share it with someone who can hold you accountable.
Schedule a weekly check-in where you let go of one detail and see what happens.
